name: foldseek-server
description: Structure search against an MMseqs2-App backend: submit, inspect, export results as files, forward hits.

tools.name: get_result_summary
tools.description: Bounded summary of a finished result

tools.name: export_result
tools.description: Write the complete result to files

tools.name: select_hits
tools.description: Name a set of hits for forwarding

tools.name: select_msa_columns
tools.description: Name alignment columns and derive their motif

tools.name: send_to
tools.description: Forward a hit or selection into a new job

base_url.title: Server URL
base_url.description: Origin of the MMseqs2-App deployment, e.g. https://search.foldseek.com

state_dir.title: State directory
state_dir.description: Where cached results, selections and exported artifacts are kept. Artifact handles are only durable if this stays put.

input_dirs.title: Readable input directories
input_dirs.description: Folders the server may read structure files from, for queryPath. Leave empty to disable.
